# Atom Shop Update 12/02/2025

**[Update]** Added screenshot of Retro Caravan Survival Tent (Season 17): 1200 Atoms

#### Fallout 1st – December

Fallout 1st members can get the Der Madison emote for free in the Atomic Shop from December 2nd to January 6th. You can find out more about becoming a Fallout 1st member here.

### Week commencing December 2nd

#### Highlight offers

From December 2nd, the RAD-Keiler package will be available in the shop for a short time!
